full_judgment:
5. Mr. Abdul Wadud Chowdhury, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the appellant has submitted firstly, that the suit itself was not maintainable without a prayer for declaration of title and it is hit by section 42 of the Specific Relief Act ; secondly, he has assailed the admissibility of a certified copy, Exhibit 5(a) under section 33 of the Evidence Act, and lastly, that it was not a proper judgment of reversal. 

 11. Lastly, the learned Advocate for the appellant has argued that it was not a proper judgment of reversal. I have gone through the judgment of both the courts below and I find that the learned Subordinate Judge has adverted to the findings of the learned Munsif and has reversed the same after proper appreciation of the evidence on record with his own reasoning’s which I find quite cogent and satisfactory. No illegality or irregularity could be pointed out by the learned Advocate in the said findings.
